datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 Surface Mount Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The BZX84C30 zener table row gives VZ min/nom/max = 28/30/32 V at IZT = 2 mA; the nominal 30 V value is used as the breakdown-voltage extraction input and the min/max bin limits are retained here as table semantics.
The same row gives ZZT maximum 80 ohm at IZT = 2 mA, ZZK maximum 300 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA, and admissible zener current IZM = 2 mA.
The zener characteristic points were digitized from the labelled BZX84C30 trace in Fig. 2; the plot is a grouped typical curve, not a guaranteed min/typ/max characteristic.

The datasheet includes typical capacitance curves in Fig. 5 but does not provide a tabulated BZX84C30 capacitance value or an unambiguous single trace assignment, so capacitance is left null rather than guessed.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
